items.q: Can I have my device repaired on the spot?
items.a: Yes. Most repairs — screen, battery, speaker — are done on-site in 30 to 60 minutes. You can walk in or make an appointment; both work.

items.q: How long is the warranty on a repair?
items.a: Standard 90-day warranty on all repairs. Doesn't work afterwards? Then we'll fix it or refund you — no cure, no pay.

items.q: Which products and brands do you offer?
items.a: We repair Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Oppo, Motorola, Sony and more. In the shop we sell cases, screen protectors, chargers, cables and car holders.

items.q: Do I need an appointment or can I just walk in?
items.a: Both work. With an appointment you'll be helped faster, but walk-ins are always welcome during opening hours.

items.q: What does a repair cost?
items.a: Screens from €49, batteries from €39, water damage diagnosis €25. For your exact model you get a fixed price upfront — no surprises.

items.q: Do you also work with businesses?

items.q: How long does a phone repair take?
items.a: Most repairs — such as a screen repair or battery replacement — are done within 30 to 60 minutes while you wait in the store.

items.q: Which brands and devices do you repair?
items.a: We repair Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Oppo, Motorola, Sony and most other smartphone and tablet brands.

items.q: Can my device always be repaired?
items.a: In the vast majority of cases, yes. If a repair isn't possible or worthwhile, we'll give you honest, free advice on the best next step.

items.q: Can I wait while my device is being repaired?
items.a: Yes, most repairs are done on the spot while you wait. For more extensive repairs we'll agree on a pickup time together.

items.q: Do you also repair older or discontinued models?
items.a: Yes, we often still have parts in stock for older models. Get in touch to check whether your model is available.

items.q: When should I have my battery replaced?
items.a: Notice your device draining quickly, switching off unexpectedly, or getting warm while charging? A battery replacement is usually the fix.

items.q: How long does a battery replacement take?
items.a: A battery replacement takes 30 to 45 minutes on average, depending on the model.

items.q: Can a different charger damage my device?
items.a: A non-original or damaged charger can harm the battery and charging port over time. We advise on and sell certified chargers.

items.q: Do I get a warranty on a new battery?
items.a: Yes, every battery replacement comes with a standard 90-day warranty.

items.q: Can I mail in my phone for repair?
items.a: Yes. Can't make it to our store in Naaldwijk? You can safely mail in your device. Once received, we inspect it and carry out the agreed repair.

items.q: How do I package my device safely for shipping?
items.a: Preferably use the original box or a sturdy box with enough padding, so the device can't shift during transport.

items.q: How long until I get my device back?
items.a: Once received, we typically repair your device within 1 to 2 business days and ship it straight back to you.

items.q: What does it cost to mail in my device?
items.a: Shipping costs depend on the shipping option you choose; we'll discuss this upfront so there are no surprises.

items.q: How long is the warranty on a repair?
items.a: A standard 90-day warranty applies to all repairs. If something's not right afterwards, we'll fix it for you free of charge.

items.q: What does a repair cost?
items.a: Screens from €49, batteries from €39, water damage diagnosis €25. You'll get a fixed price for your exact model upfront.

items.q: Do I pay upfront or after the repair?
items.a: You only pay once the repair has been carried out and you're happy with the result.

items.q: Does my warranty become void if I've already tried to fix it myself?
items.a: Previous repair attempts by you or a third party can affect the warranty. We always assess this fairly, case by case.

items.q: Will I lose my data during a repair?
items.a: In most cases all your data and photos remain untouched. To be safe, we always recommend making a backup beforehand.

items.q: What happens to my data when I hand in my device?
items.a: We handle your data carefully and only use your device for the agreed repair. No data is kept once the repair is complete.

items.q: Do I need to unlock my device for a repair?
items.a: For some repairs we need to be able to test the device. We only ask for this when it's genuinely necessary for your repair.

items.q: Do I need an appointment or can I just walk in?
items.a: Both work. With an appointment you'll be helped faster, but walk-ins are always welcome during opening hours.

items.q: What are your opening hours?
items.a: We're open Monday through Saturday; closed on Sundays. Check our contact page for current hours.

items.q: Where can I find you?
items.a: You'll find our store at Molenstraat 2 in Naaldwijk, in the heart of the Westland.

items.q: Do you also work with businesses?
items.a: Yes. We serve 120+ Westland businesses with invoiced billing, pickup service and same-day SLA for devices dropped off before 11am.

zakelijk.seoTitle: Business smartphone repairs for companies in the Westland region
seoParagraphs: A fully functioning smartphone or tablet is essential for many businesses. Employees need to stay connected, appointments need to continue without interruption, and daily operations should never be delayed because of faulty devices. For more than 14 years, 4Mobiles has supported businesses throughout Naaldwijk and the Westland region with professional smartphone and tablet repairs, business services and personal advice.

Every day we help entrepreneurs, retailers, healthcare organizations, schools and many other businesses with a wide variety of repairs. From cracked iPhone displays and Samsung battery replacements to charging issues, camera repairs and everyday accessories. Thanks to our extensive experience, many repairs can be completed within 30–60 minutes, allowing employees to get back to work quickly.

We also help businesses reduce future downtime. High-quality screen protectors, durable phone cases, reliable chargers and carefully selected accessories help prevent unnecessary damage and extend the lifespan of business devices. Clear communication, transparent pricing and personal service are at the core of everything we do.

Whether you manage a single company phone or an entire fleet of smartphones and tablets, we offer a practical solution tailored to your business. With one dedicated point of contact, short communication lines and fast turnaround times, you can focus on running your organization while we keep your devices performing reliably.

If you are looking for a trusted partner for business smartphone repairs, iPhone repairs, Samsung repairs or professional advice in Naaldwijk or the Westland region, 4Mobiles is ready to help. We provide practical solutions that keep your employees connected and your business running without unnecessary interruptions.

iphone-scherm-stuk.title: iPhone screen broken? These are your options
iphone-scherm-stuk.excerpt: Everything about screen problems, costs, and the best solution for your situation.
body: A cracked iPhone screen is annoying, but it happens to everyone at some point. The big question is: what do you do now? You have roughly three options: repair through a specialist, DIY repair with a kit, or buy a new device. In most cases, professional repair is the smartest and safest choice, especially if your iPhone is less than three years old.

Screen repair costs vary greatly by model. For an iPhone 13 or 14, repair costs at a good service point are typically between €89 and €149, depending on the screen type (OLED or LCD). Newer models like the iPhone 15 Pro can be slightly more expensive due to the Dynamic Island display. Compare this with a new device that quickly costs €800 or more — repair is almost always cheaper.

At 4Mobiles in Naaldwijk we repair iPhone screens in about 30 minutes. We use only quality parts and provide six months warranty on the repair. Feel free to stop by for a free diagnosis, or call us in advance to discuss your specific model and expected costs. No surprises.

batterij-leeg.title: Battery dead? Here's what to do
batterij-leeg.excerpt: Why your battery drains quickly and when it's better to replace it.
body: A smartphone battery has a limited lifespan. After about 500 full charge cycles, the capacity noticeably decreases. This means a phone you've used for two or three years won't last as long on a single charge. Do you recognise yourself in charging multiple times a day, when once a day used to be enough? Then battery replacement is probably the solution.

There are a few simple things you can do yourself to make your battery last longer. Charge your phone preferably between 20% and 80%, avoid extreme temperatures, and turn off energy-hungry features like Always-On Display when you don't need them. On an iPhone you can check your battery health via Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

Has the battery capacity dropped below 80%? Then it's smart to have it replaced. At 4Mobiles we swap batteries for most iPhone and Samsung models within 30 minutes. Prices start from €39.95 and we provide six months warranty. A fresh battery feels like a new device — for a fraction of the price.

iphone-kapot.title: iPhone broken? Here's how to handle it
iphone-kapot.excerpt: Step by step what you can do when your iPhone stops working.
body: Your iPhone isn't working anymore. That can mean many things: the screen stays black, the device won't start, there's water damage, or certain buttons don't work. In any case, it's important to stay calm and work step by step. Panic doesn't help, but a good diagnosis does.

Step one is to try a forced restart. On an iPhone 8 or newer, quickly press the volume up button, then the volume down button, and then hold the side button until the Apple logo appears. If this doesn't help, there's likely a hardware or software issue you can't solve yourself. Don't try to open the device if you have no experience with this — you can make the damage worse.

If water damage is involved, turn the device off immediately (if possible), remove the SIM card and lay the device flat with the charging port facing down. Don't use a hair dryer or rice: these don't help and can make things worse. Bring the device to a specialist as soon as possible. At 4Mobiles we always do a free diagnosis first, so you know exactly what's wrong and what it costs to repair. Transparency is our priority.

tablet-scherm-kapot.title: Tablet screen broken? Repair or replace?
tablet-scherm-kapot.excerpt: When repair is worth it and when a new device is the smarter choice.
body: A tablet with a broken screen is much more inconvenient than a phone with the same damage — the screen is after all the main interface. Whether you have an iPad, a Samsung Galaxy Tab or another tablet, the choice between repair and replacement depends on a few practical factors: the age of the device, repair costs and how intensively you use it.

As a rule of thumb: if repair costs exceed half the purchase value of a comparable new model, replacement is the wiser choice. For recent models (1 to 2 years old), repair is almost always more economical. An iPad screen repair at our shop typically costs between €99 and €179, depending on the model and whether the screen also has a touch issue.

Another consideration is whether only the glass is broken, or also the LCD panel underneath. A cracked outer glass without display issues is cheaper to repair. Do you see black spots, colour streaks, or does the touch no longer work properly? Then the entire display is damaged and costs are higher. Visit 4Mobiles for a free inspection so you get honest advice before making a decision.
